title: trackiwi
description: Position, travel and vehicle health from a trackiwi GPS tracker. Flux; InfluxDB 2.x / Cloud; Grafana 10+.

list.name: tracker
list.label: Tracker
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "tracker_name", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position", start: -365d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "lat")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: int(v: r._time) / 1000000}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "voltage_v")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "battery_pct")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "satellites")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "gnss_quality")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "lat", "lon"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "speed_kmh")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trackiwi_position" and r.tracker_name == "${tracker}" and r._field == "distance_m")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
